danger.title: Danger zone

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?

deleteDialog.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}: {names}

add.title: Add skill

file.dropHint: or drop it here · .md, .markdown or .txt · up to 20,000 characters
file.wrongType: Only .md, .markdown or .txt files can be imported.
file.tooLong: The file is longer than 20,000 characters.

url.label: URL (https:// only)
url.nameHint: Optional — taken from the file's first heading if left blank.
url.hint: Fetched by the server: https only, public hosts only, up to 64 KB. Nothing is saved until you click Import skill.
url.failed: Could not import from this URL.

add.importNote: Imported skills are saved switched off — review them, then enable them on the Config tab.
add.importedToast: Imported {name} — switched off until you enable it

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it

stats.activity: {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} · {findings, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}

empty.title: Not used by any agent
empty.body: Attach it from an agent's Skills tab.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body. Diff shows what changed from the previous version; restoring creates a new version and never rewrites history.
versions.noChanges: No differences from the previous version.
versions.confirmBody: This creates v{next} with the body of v{version}. History is never rewritten.

conflicts.title: {count, plural, one {# merge conflict} other {# merge conflicts}}
conflicts.subtitle: These conventions contradict the skill and were not inserted. Choose per rule, then Save on Config.
conflicts.versionMessage: Resolved {count, plural, one {# convention conflict} other {# convention conflicts}}
conflicts.appendedNote: {count, plural, one {The existing text for # rule was not found, so it was appended at the end.} other {The existing text for # rules was not found, so they were appended at the end.}} Review the body before saving.

suggestions.title: Link this skill to agents
suggestions.subtitle: Agents that look like a fit by convention category, skill type and shared words. Accept links the skill to that agent right away; Reject removes it from this list.
suggestions.disabledNote: Skill is disabled — enable it on Config to include it in prompts.
suggestions.linkedToast: {count, plural, one {Linked to # agent} other {Linked to # agents}}

reasons.type: {count, plural, one {already uses # {type} skill} other {already uses # {type} skills}}

safety.bannerBody: This skill contains prompt-injection patterns, so it is switched off and cannot be enabled or linked to an agent. Remove the highlighted text and save to make it a normal skill.
safety.editorBody: The highlighted text looks like a prompt injection. You can still save, but a flagged skill stays switched off and cannot be linked to an agent.
safety.scanFailed: Could not check the body; the server checks it again on save.
safety.fixedNote: No prompt-injection patterns left. Save to make this a normal skill again.
safety.toggleLocked: Flagged as a possible prompt injection — fix the body before enabling it
safety.highlightTitle: Body with the flagged text highlighted
